text:
alex: Heads up — p95 decode spike on canary after yesterday's runtime merge (commit r4). Seeing ~2.4x tail on short+long mixes. profiler points at a different attn kernel being chosen for mid-length sequences, fallback_attn instead of attn_fused :thinking:
maya: saw the alert too. CI perf bot flagged the canary job: https://ci.redwood/1234 :eyes:
dev-ci: CI Perf Alert: canary/runtime-suite p95 increased from 42ms -> 102ms after merge r4. Trace id: c-9f3b
ben: can you paste the profiler snippet? I can start a quick bisect.
alex: here's a tiny trace from the canary run (trimmed):
```
profile:
  decode_path:
    select_kernel: attn_fallback
    reason: prefetch_threshold_mismatch
    wall_ms: 98.4
  prev_baseline:
    select_kernel: attn_fused
    wall_ms: 41.2
```
chris: repro locally with the nightly image: `./scripts/perf_local --model=redwood-7b --seq=512 --batch=1 --seed=42` and you'll see the selector flip around 120-150 tokens. I dumped kernel chooser logs:
```
[kernel-chooser] seq=128 shape=(B, S): chose attn_fallback score=0.87
[kernel-chooser] seq=64  shape=(B, S): chose attn_fused    score=0.92
```
nina: that smells like the prefetch/batching heuristic change from r4 — we changed the dynamic_prefetch_threshold to favor prefetching earlier, but didn't update the kernel scoring for mixed-length workloads.
ben: starting a git bisect now to narrow to the exact commit in the merge stack.
ben: quick update: bisect points to commit 5f1d8a2 (runtime: prefetch heuristic rewrite). Confirmed on a canary VM by toggling that commit out: p95 drops back to baseline.
alex: nice catch. can we hotfix by reverting just the heuristic change or add a guard to keep kernel scoring for attn_fused when short-long ratio < 0.3?
maya: +1 to guard. full revert is heavier. ops, canary hold? :hand:
ops-bot: Canary hold requested by @maya. Rollout paused for runtime service. Scheduled rollback window: in 20m unless a patch is merged.
chris: quick patch idea — in kernel_selector.cc add an override:
```
if (short_long_mix < 0.3 && candidate == ATTn_FALLBACK) {
  favor = favor - 0.5; // bias back to fused
}
```
I'll open PR with unit + perf test.
nina: for immediate mitigation we can toggle `dynamic_prefetch_enabled=false` in canary config. That unblocks user traffic while patch lands.
alex: please do that and link the config change here.
ben: PR up: #4523 with the guard and perf regression test. bench shows p95 back to 44ms on canary image. Requesting review from @chris @nina.
maya: reviewing now. If tests green we can merge and unpause.
ops-bot: Config toggle applied to canary: dynamic_prefetch_enabled=false. Traffic reduced on canary by 80%.
alex: thanks all — good triage. Follow-up: add a small e2e with mixed short/long sequences to prevent regressions and update the rollout checklist.
chris: noted, I'll add the e2e to runtime/perf and a short doc blurb.
ben: will keep the bisect notes in the PR. tagging perf leads.
maya: :thumbsup: Great teamwork — moving to close the canary alert after merge.
alex: closing loop once merged + canary validated. Thanks!
